content.title: Netanyahu Killed LIVE: Israeli PM’S “SIX-FINGERED” Video Sparks Assassination Rumors Linked To Iran
content.text: Rumours about Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s death have exploded across social media during the ongoing Israel–Iran war, leaving many people confused about what is actually happening. Viral posts claim Netanyahu was killed during the conflict, while others suggest a recent video of him addressing the nation may have been created using artificial intelligence. But is there any truth behind these claims? Or is this another example of misinformation spreading during a time of war? In this video, we break down the origin of the rumours, examine the viral screenshots and AI claims, and look at what official sources are actually saying about Netanyahu’s status.
